title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Job Information Date Opened 11/19/2026 Job Type Full time City Chennai State/Province Tamil Nadu Country India Zip/Postal Code 600096 Industry Technology Job Description Site Reliability Engineer – Job Description Role purpose Improve availability, reliability and operational resilience of AWS/Azure-hosted platform services; own infrastructure-level troubleshooting and execution beyond L1 monitoring. Key responsibilities Provide L2 engineering for EC2, EBS, FSx, S3, ECS, Auto Scaling, RDS and agreed Azure compute/storage/infrastructure. Investigate degradation using Datadog, CloudWatch, AWS Health Dashboard and Azure telemetry; correlate application, container, host and cloud signals. Resolve/coordinate disk and storage capacity issues on Odoo EC2 servers and EBS volumes; validate filesystem growth, volume use and service impact. Troubleshoot ECS task-state changes, restart alerts, unhealthy services and deployment issues for MSSQL clusters and Commerce-api. Execute approved ECS service updates/forced deployments and EC2 Auto Scaling Group instance refreshes; validate instance health, capacity and application recovery. Review AWS account health events and determine infrastructure impact, mitigation and escalation requirements. Support network diagnosis, including replication path and port 1433 reachability over designated VPN; coordinate firewall/routing/VPN changes with authorized owners. Own infrastructure monitoring quality; review Datadog dashboards weekly, identify telemetry gaps and tune thresholds with approval. Contribute to AWS/Azure capacity management through storage growth, compute utilization, scaling and resource allocation analysis. Validate EC2 OS patch compliance for Windows, Linux and WordPress hosts; coordinate windows, pre/post checks and exception reporting. Review CSPM findings, validate cloud configuration context and coordinate remediation with designated security/cloud stakeholders. Support S3 archive validation and restore prerequisites; DBA retains database-level recovery ownership. Plan and participate in quarterly DR exercises for SQL Server FSx and RDS PaaS; validate infrastructure dependencies and recovery. Automate repetitive health checks, alert enrichment, evidence capture and routine remediation using PowerShell/Python/cloud-native automation, subject to review and approval. Maintain infrastructure runbooks, scripts, monitoring standards and known-error documentation; lead infrastructure RCA. Required skills and experience Hands-on AWS operations: EC2, EBS, FSx, S3, ECS, Auto Scaling, RDS and AWS Health. Working Azure infrastructure services and monitoring. ECS/container operations and deployment troubleshooting. Linux/Windows administration, storage, patching and service troubleshooting. Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor and observability. TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewall, VPN and service-port validation. Reliability, incident response, capacity, resilience, DR and PowerShell/Python automation. KPIs / expected outcomes Cloud/platform incidents handled within agreed SLAs. Monitoring signal quality improved and avoidable alert noise reduced. Approved instance refreshes, ECS deployments and patch activities evidenced. Capacity and cloud health risks proactively identified. Automation with measurable effort/response-time reduction. DR findings and reliability actions closed. Authority and boundaries SRE owns infrastructure/platform engineering, not application code fixes or database-level tuning; database incidents are worked jointly with DBA. Production changes, failovers, security remediation and network-policy changes require approval. AI NOC is not assumed to replace SRE; automation requires human approval/rollback controls.
